message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Growth Rate", "construction": "Annual percentage change in inventories (from Compustat item INVT) over the prior fiscal year, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Rapid inventory accumulation may reflect overproduction or expected demand shortfalls, leading to future negative earnings surprises.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Cash Flow Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly cash flow from operations (Compustat OANCF) over the prior three years, divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with stable cash flows are perceived as less risky, but riskier firms may command higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Past R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Change in R&D expense (Compustat XRD) as a percentage of sales over the past two years.", "rationale": "Increases in R&D intensity may signal future growth opportunities not yet incorporated in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth", "construction": "Annual growth in current assets (Compustat ACT), scaled by prior year total assets.", "rationale": "Aggressive expansion of current assets may signal empire-building or low investment efficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Officers' Compensation Ratio", "construction": "Total officers’ compensation disclosed in annual proxy statements divided by total sales.", "rationale": "Higher compensation ratios may signal agency problems and weaker governance, leading to lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Depreciation Policy Aggressiveness", "construction": "Depreciation expense (Compustat DP) as a fraction of gross property, plant, and equipment (PPENT) over the past year.", "rationale": "Aggressive depreciation may indicate conservative accounting or signal undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Pension Expense to Assets", "construction": "Annual pension expense (Compustat XPR) divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "Higher pension expenses may indicate stronger commitments to employees but could also signal underfunded plans and future cash flow constraints.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Receivables to Sales Change", "construction": "Change in accounts receivable (Compustat RECT) as a percentage of sales over the prior year.", "rationale": "A rapid increase in receivables relative to sales may indicate loosening credit standards or deteriorating customer quality.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Auditor Size Indicator", "construction": "Binary indicator for whether the firm’s auditor is one of the ‘Big 8’ accounting firms (from proxy disclosures and auditor lists).", "rationale": "Firms audited by larger, reputable auditors may have higher transparency and lower risk of misstatement.", "higher_returns_for": "firms not audited by Big 8 auditors"}, {"name": "Employee Count Growth", "construction": "Annual percentage change in number of employees (from 10-K filings), scaled by prior year employee count.", "rationale": "Rapid employee growth may signal overexpansion or overoptimism by management.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
